privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.text:
« Guilds of the Deep » is a student project developed as part of the École 42 Belgium program, currently hosted in a local environment (localhost) for educational purposes.

When using the Service, certain data may be stored in order to allow the game and its associated features to function. This data may include your email address, password, username, avatar, game progression, map-related data, and other information necessary for the operation of the Service.

The Service does not use tracking cookies, analytics tools, or third-party services for advertising, payment, or profiling purposes.

The stored data is used solely to enable account creation and management and to provide the features of the Service. It is not used for advertising, profiling, or resale purposes.

As the project is currently running in a local environment, each instance of the Service has its own database. The data is therefore stored within the environment corresponding to the instance being used and is not centralized on an online infrastructure controlled by the project team.

The retention period of the data depends on the lifetime of the database used by the instance. A local instance may be reset, deleted, or stopped as part of the development or at the end of the project.

The data is not intentionally shared with third parties by the development team. Access to the data nevertheless depends on the local environment in which the Service is running.

We implement reasonable measures to protect the data. However, as the Service is a student project under development and currently operates in a local environment, production-level security cannot be guaranteed.

This policy may be updated during the development of the project. The date indicated at the top of this page corresponds to the latest version of the policy.

For any questions regarding this policy or the processing of data as part of the project, you may contact one of the team members listed above.

terms_of_service.title: Terms of Service
terms_of_service.text:
« Guilds of the Deep » (hereinafter referred to as « the Service ») is a student project developed as part of the École 42 Belgium program. The Service is currently under development and hosted in a local environment (localhost) for educational and non-commercial purposes.

By creating an account on the Service, you agree to these Terms of Service and the associated Privacy Policy. If you do not agree to these terms, you must not use the Service.

Creating an account requires a valid email address and a password. The Service may also store a username, avatar, game progression, map-related data, and other data necessary for the operation of the game. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential and for all activity carried out through your account.

The Service is a student project provided « as is », without any guarantee of availability, continuity, or absence of bugs. It may be interrupted, reset, or deleted at any time without prior notice, particularly as part of the development process or at the end of the academic program.

You agree to use the Service reasonably and not to attempt to compromise its operation, including through unauthorized access, exploitation of vulnerabilities, or any other action that could disrupt the Service or its execution environment.

As the Service is currently running in a local environment, data is stored in the database associated with the instance being used. This database may be reset, deleted, or made inaccessible as part of the development of the project. The Service does not currently guarantee any public functionality for remotely deleting accounts or data.

These terms may be modified at any time during the development of the project. The update date at the top of this page reflects the latest version in effect.

For any questions regarding these terms, you may contact one of the team members listed above.
